name: Jeeter x 5 Infused Prerolls | Autumn Haze
description: Autumn Haze packs a sweet and fruity apple flavor, accented by sugary honey and a touch of nuttiness. The aroma is much like how it would smell if you were indulging in a fresh, warm mug of apple cider while taking a walk through the woods just after the rain. The Autumn Haze high is as delicious, with a soothing and stimulating overtone that settles into both the mind and body with a slow-building, creeping effect. You'll find your mind lifted into a happy state of euphoria, which leaves you feeling creatively inspired and quite outgoing
